eyeclean-r54.description: eyeclean-r48 with EyeGuard and the reflection-presence classifier fine-tuned across iris sizes 8-160 px (better on close-up photos, fewer false edits); same EyeRestoreTX (57.5M); see MODEL_CARD.md
eyeclean-r54.input_note: any input colour EyeClean supports; tested on 1080p Rec.709 video, linear Rec.709 EXR and phone JPEG photos

eyeclean-r48.description: EyeGuard + reflection-presence classifier + EyeRestoreTX (57.5M), invariance fine-tuned, with a 0.5 px softened restorer input; see MODEL_CARD.md
eyeclean-r48.input_note: any input colour EyeClean supports; tested on 1080p Rec.709 video and linear Rec.709 EXR

best_single_r48.description: the development bundle eyeclean-r48 was made from: the same tensors plus an unused five-frame CNN slot and a development manifest; identical output
